story_steps: Earl takes the booth nearest the door.
He mentions a bridge closure that lengthened his route.
He brings a clipping about the highway.
He asks whether Dot will still be here next week.
He leaves a penciled route around the closure.
Vonda finishes a difficult hospital shift.
She explains the eye drops that keep her from blinking.
She orders food for a colleague working late.
She returns the borrowed menu she forgot in her bag.
She promises Dot an empty chair when the week ends.
The twins arrive separately and choose nearby booths.
They joke about being mistaken for each other.
One twin orders for both while the other calls home.
They bring a school photograph showing their matching faces.
They leave together, arguing about whose turn it is to drive.
Coach asks for the usual and takes the same chair.
He remembers the players who used to stop here.
He leaves a team schedule near the register.
He asks Dot to save a pie for a reunion.
He returns with a photograph of the old team.
Ines arrives after the late radio show.
She tells Dot about a caller who never speaks.
She shares the weather forecast for the highway.
She dedicates a quiet record to the night workers.
She leaves a note promising a mention of the diner.

story_steps: Ricky comes in wearing an oversized hoodie.
He admits he has missed the last bus.
He offers to sweep the doorway for a meal.
He finds a reliable ride home after the shift.
He thanks Dot and leaves the borrowed broom beside the door.
